correctness.rationale: The back condition on a maximal-depth source preimage of every target cluster forces m≥max c_t and k≥Δ. Distinct target internal clusters require distinct source internal vertices; a full k-ary tree with j internal nodes has kj+1 nodes. Padding the internal skeleton with leaves is a valid p-morphism and achieves the lower bound. Equality forces unique internal preimages and an isomorphic internal skeleton, hence unique minimizing quotient shape. Independent choices of surjective source-cluster maps and inclusion-exclusion on compulsory adjacent target leaves yield exactly the formula. Direct function-enumerating standard-library checker output: VERIFY_OK shapes 57 brute_tree_counts 24 cluster_brute 4 shape_rigidity 375 branch_obstruction 259. These finite checks do not prove universal quantifiers.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Published prescribed-source theorems are broad in arbitrary tree shapes: general p-morphism existence is characterized by a topological-minor criterion and general map counts by inclusion-exclusion. They may compute an answer for a separately supplied candidate, but do not themselves optimize the source over all regular pretree shapes, classify all minimizing shapes, or count maps with larger mutually accessible target clusters. The three-level-target theorem addresses a different target class.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Wołoszyn establishes a regular source by repeating all branches with possible exponential replication; the new theorem obtains linear minimum m(k|I|+1), canonical quotient shape, and automorphism-weighted count. The tree embedding theorem can decide whether a particular source covers a tree, and the counting recurrence gives counts for a prescribed tree pair, but neither implies the minimizing source or pretree cluster formula without further argument. The special-target branching threshold is not this sharp general-source optimization.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Finite rooted pretrees are S4 Kripke frames with tree-structured quotient and mutually accessible clusters; in the special case of singleton clusters, p-morphisms are continuous open maps and the existence of a prescribed source map is equivalent to an LCA-preserving topological-minor embedding. This equivalence does not state a minimum-over-regular-sources, rigid unique minimizer, or weighted cluster multiplicity. The primary preprint supplies a nonminimal regular unfolding.

value.rationale: The May 2026 finite regularization construction gives a qualitative way to replace arbitrary finite tree-quotient S4 frames by uniformly branching/equicardinal-cluster frames. It can replicate a long unary tail exponentially. The new minimum m(k|I|+1) is linear in the target nonleaf count, the minimizer is forced up to isomorphism, and the weighted exact map count distinguishes different leaf-cluster sizes. These solve a natural quantitative refinement of a construction used for finite-frame modal completeness; not a rote table or arbitrary slice.
